content: There is the Lean Eval Project by @Kim Morrison, https://lean-lang.org/eval/ and #Model comparisons for Lean > LeanEval . I would find something like this also interesting for Formal Conjectures. Having a Comparator based Benchmark, which simply ingests Problems from the Formal Conjectures Repo for Autoformalization (Category Solved) and Autoproving (Category Open) and compares Models.
